3. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/6a13779a3746cf9f5206b99e_switch-horizontal-02__f5db0e27bb35.svg) Can I change or cancel my plan anytime? Yes. Close offers both monthly and annual plans. Monthly subscriptions can be upgraded, downgraded, or canceled anytime. Annual plans offer discounted pricing and can be upgraded as your team grows. Downgrades or cancellations take effect at the end of the billing term.
4. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/6a172e69827b55029922b0a3_receipt-check__3df99b8e1cf5.svg) How does Close pricing work? Close combines your CRM, calling, SMS, and AI workflows in one platform. Pricing is based on seats for your team, actual usage for calling and SMS, and AI credits used by Chloe and other AI features. Every plan includes AI credits to get started, and additional usage can be added as needed.
5. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/6a172e691fdaacf23ff1b0f6_phone-call-01__0eafad3c8307.svg) How much do calling and SMS cost? Calling and SMS are usage-based and passed through at cost, which keeps pricing flexible as your team scales. Most outbound calls cost around $0.02/minute, and phone numbers start at about $1/month. Your free trial includes calling credits so you can test real conversations, workflows, and Chloe before upgrading.
6. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/687578ef3481f7f8a423c994_icon-ai-summaries__909f27fb84af.svg) What is Chloe, and which plans include it? Every Close plan includes access to Chloe, Close’s built-in AI sales agent. Chloe can call leads automatically, qualify prospects through live conversations, book meetings, update CRM records after calls, enrich lead data, and answer questions about your pipeline inside Close. Growth and Scale plans unlock more advanced automation, workflows, and AI capabilities for higher-volume sales teams.
7. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/6a172e681a80eb9ba7f07391_beaker-02__7a9facb373a4.svg) Can I try Chloe during my free trial? Yes. Because Chloe is built directly into Close, you can set her up quickly and start using her on real leads during your trial. Chloe can call leads, qualify prospects, book meetings, update CRM records, enrich lead data, and answer questions about your pipeline — all natively inside Close. Since Chloe works directly inside the CRM, she already has context from your contacts, communication history, and pipeline activity.
8. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/6a172e69827b55029922b0c3_scales-01__2af445f2d58a.svg) What's the difference between Growth and Scale? Growth is ideal for scaling teams that want automation, workflows, and AI built into their sales process. Scale is designed for higher-volume teams that need more operational control, advanced dialing power, and deeper team management features. If your reps spend most of their day prospecting and calling, Scale is usually the right fit. Many teams start on Growth and upgrade to Scale as their team and sales motion expand.
9. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/6a172e691a80eb9ba7f073c4_coins-swap-01__1d09aec900f1.svg) How easy is it to switch from another CRM? Close includes built-in importers for platforms like HubSpot, Pipedrive, and HighLevel, plus spreadsheet imports. Most teams can import their data and get up and running quickly.
11. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/6a172e69970a1f21ba601544_check-verified-02__6a3137b48ba8.svg) Do you offer a money-back guarantee? Yes. Close offers a 30-day money-back guarantee after purchase. You can also upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time.

04. ![](https://close.com/assets/images/6a172e69827b55029922b0a3_receipt-check__3df99b8e1cf5.svg)





    ### How does Close pricing work?





    Close combines your CRM, calling, SMS, and AI workflows in one platform.



    Pricing is based on seats for your team, actual usage for calling and SMS, and AI credits used by Chloe and other AI features.



    Every plan includes AI credits to get started, and additional usage can be added as needed.

    ### What's the difference between Growth and Scale?





    Growth is ideal for scaling teams that want automation, workflows, and AI built into their sales process.



    Scale is designed for higher-volume teams that need more operational control, advanced dialing power, and deeper team management features.



    If your reps spend most of their day prospecting and calling, Scale is usually the right fit.



    Many teams start on Growth and upgrade to Scale as their team and sales motion expand.

    That said, our team is available if you want help evaluating Close, designing workflows, migrating from another CRM, or planning for larger or more complex sales operations.

# Close CRM Review in 2026: Features, Pricing, Pros & Cons
## **Close CRM pricing: Breaking down the cost**
![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6482fc3c808f4e9db58cda1d/6839670b374fb632de9ede44_close-crm-pricing-plans.webp)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6482fc3c808f4e9db58cda1d/683967192b65839297acf193_close-crm-pricing-plans2.webp)

[Close CRM offers a tiered pricing structure](https://zeeg.me/en/blog/post/close-crm-pricing) that scales with business needs.

| Plan | Solo | Essentials | Growth | Scale |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| **Monthly Price** | $12/user/month | $45/user/month | $129/user/month | $179/user/month |
| **Annual Price** | $9/user/month | $35/user/month | $99/user/month | $139/user/month |
| **Key Features** | Limited to 1 user, up to 10k leads, basic CRM | Unlimited contacts, built-in calling/SMS, multiple pipelines | Automated workflows, Power Dialer, AI Email Assistant | Predictive Dialer, call coaching, role-based permissions |
| **Workflows** | None | None | Included | Included |
| **Call Recording** | 30-day retention | 30-day retention | 90-day retention | Unlimited retention |
| **Custom Fields** | 25 | 25 | 250 | 250 |
| **Bulk Email** | Not included | Not included | Included | Included |
| **AI Features** | None | None | AI Email Assistant, Lead Summaries | AI Lead Summaries, Call Coaching |
| **Best For** | Individual users getting started | Small teams needing basic CRM | Growing teams needing automation | Larger teams with advanced needs |

**All Close CRM plans come with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.** **This allows teams to test the platform before committing to a purchase.**

### **What to make of Close CRM's pricing tiers**
The Growth plan (marked as "Most Popular") unlocks key automation tools, suggesting Close expects most business customers to gravitate toward this tier.

**Feature accessibility**: Unlike many CRMs that heavily restrict basic plans, Close's Essentials tier at $35/user/month includes unlimited contacts, leads, and pipelines—core CRM functionality that many competitors charge extra for or limit significantly.

## **Best practices to get started with Close CRM**

If you're considering implementing Close CRM, these best practices can help ensure a successful rollout:

### **1\. Start with a clean database**

Beginning with organized data sets the foundation for CRM success. Take time to thoroughly clean your existing contact database before migration. This process should include removing any duplicate entries that could create confusion and updating outdated information to ensure accuracy from day one. Standardizing formatting across all records helps maintain consistency, while identifying which custom fields you'll need allows you to capture industry-specific information that matters to your business. This preparatory work might seem tedious, but it pays dividends through increased adoption and more reliable reporting down the line.

### **2\. Define your sales process**

Close's pipeline features shine brightest when configured to match your actual sales methodology. Start by documenting your current sales stages from initial contact through closing. For each stage, identify the key activities that typically occur and specific criteria that should trigger movement to the next phase. Consider what data points provide the most valuable insights for your team and ensure they're prominently tracked. This thoughtful mapping creates a CRM that reinforces your proven process rather than forcing your team to adapt to generic workflows that might not fit your business reality.

### **3\. Set up smart views**

Smart Views in Close transform how sales representatives organize their daily work. Create focused views that help reps quickly identify which leads need immediate attention. Views for new leads awaiting initial contact ensure quick response times, while hot prospect views highlight opportunities nearing decision points. Time-sensitive views for deals expected to close this month keep revenue targets front and center, and renewal views prevent valuable customers from slipping away unnoticed. These customized perspectives help sales teams work more strategically by surfacing the right opportunities at the right time.

### **4\. Implement gradually**

A phased implementation approach prevents overwhelming your team with too much change at once. Begin with core contact management features to establish the CRM as the central repository for customer information. Once this foundation is solid, introduce the communication tools that make daily outreach more efficient. With these basics mastered, layer in automation capabilities to eliminate repetitive tasks and ensure consistent follow-up. Finally, incorporate advanced reporting to drive continuous improvement. This measured approach builds confidence and skills progressively, leading to stronger adoption compared to an all-at-once implementation.

### **5\. Train your team effectively**

Thoughtful training dramatically improves adoption rates and return on investment. Rather than generic overviews, provide hands-on sessions where representatives can practice with realistic scenarios relevant to their daily work. Develop process documentation specific to your unique workflow, avoiding generic materials that don't address your team's actual activities. Throughout training, emphasize the concrete benefits each feature provides to individual users—how it makes their job easier, saves time, or helps them succeed. Consider creating an internal champions program that recognizes and rewards early adopters who can then help bring others along.

### **6\. Establish data entry standards**

Consistent data practices form the backbone of effective CRM usage. Develop clear naming conventions for accounts, opportunities, and activities to ensure everyone speaks the same language within the system. Identify which fields must be completed for different record types, striking a balance between capturing essential information and overwhelming users with too many required entries. Document expectations around activity logging - what interactions should be recorded, how quickly, and with what level of detail. Create standardized email and call templates that maintain brand consistency while saving time. These shared standards create a reliable data foundation that supports both individual productivity and organizational insights.

### **7\. Review and refine**

Post-implementation refinement turns an adequate CRM deployment into an exceptional one. Regularly review adoption metrics to understand which features are gaining traction and which might need additional focus. Create open channels for user feedback and take this input seriously—your front-line users often have the most practical insights into what's working well or causing friction. Look for patterns in the feedback to identify systemic issues that might require configuration adjustments. Where necessary, provide targeted follow-up training to address specific skill gaps that emerge. Remember that CRM implementation is an iterative process; the most successful deployments evolve continuously based on real-world experience and changing business needs.

## **Frequently Asked Questions about Close CRM**

### **What is Close CRM best used for?**

Close CRM is best used for managing the entire sales cycle, from lead capture through deal closure. It particularly excels at streamlining communication with prospects and customers through its integrated calling, email, and SMS features.

### **Does Close CRM have a free version?**

No, Close CRM doesn't offer a free version. However, it does provide a 14-day free trial that gives access to all features, allowing teams to thoroughly test the platform before committing.

### **How does Close CRM's pricing compare to competitors?**

Close CRM's pricing starts higher than some entry-level CRMs but lower than enterprise solutions. Its Base plan begins at $19/user/month, with the more functional Startup plan at $49/user/month (billed annually). This positions it as a mid-market solution.

### **Is Close CRM suitable for small businesses?**

Yes, Close CRM can work well for small businesses, particularly those that have a defined sales process and make regular contact with prospects by phone and email. However, very small businesses or solopreneurs might find the cost prohibitive compared to free or lower-cost alternatives.

According to Close, their platform can be implemented up to 50% faster than competing CRMs. Many teams can be up and running in days rather than weeks, especially if they're importing from a clean database and have clear processes defined.

Close CRM integrates with over 100 applications directly, plus thousands more through Zapier. Key integrations include Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoom, Slack, DocuSign, and popular marketing platforms.

### **How is Close CRM's mobile experience?**

Close offers comprehensive mobile apps for both iOS and Android that allow users to access contact information, log activities, send communications, and update deals from anywhere. The mobile experience provides most of the functionality of the desktop version in a mobile-friendly interface.
